hook.name: AggHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook that acts as an on-chain DEX aggregator for a USDC.e/USDC pair on Polygon. On beforeSwap, it queries prices across up to 11 v4 pools and 1 v3 pool, routes the swap through the optimal path, charges a protocol fee via donate, and returns a BeforeSwapDelta to fully override the standard pool fill. Liquidity addition and pool initialization are restricted to an admin address.
